scope.flow: BuilderWallet admin initialization and builder-fee sweep
evidence: Builder wallet admin is fully mutable by any caller, enabling takeover and sweeping of builder‑fee balances.
- Link: https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-12-panoptic/blob/main/contracts/RiskEngine.sol#L2319-L2321 (`sweep` uses `builderAdmin`)
- Link: https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-12-panoptic/blob/main/contracts/CollateralTracker.sol#L1558-L1571 (builder fee transferred to `feeRecipient`)
- Link: https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-12-panoptic/blob/main/contracts/CollateralTracker.sol#L1642-L1650 (builder fee on burn)

`BuilderWallet.init` is publicly callable and lacks any access control or one‑time guard. This allows any EOA to set `builderAdmin` after deployment and call `sweep` to drain all accumulated builder fees. The wallet is a custody point for protocol‑generated fee flow, so the impact is direct theft of builder‑split revenue and loss of incentive alignment for builders/referrers.
Any EOA can overwrite `builderAdmin` and sweep all builder fees from `BuilderWallet`, causing immediate loss of builder revenue.
